'''Flame-colored robes''' were hooded [[Clothing/Legends|garments]] made of [[trevella cloth]]. They were created by the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] and worn by the [[Handmaiden/Legends|handmaidens]] who served [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] when she was the [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|monarch of Naboo]]. The [[Color/Legends|red]], orange, and yellow ombré of the [[Robe/Legends|robes]] was symbolic of a [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] sunrise.

==Description==
Flame-colored robes<ref name="TPM junior" /> were [[Clothing/Legends|garments]] made of soft [[trevella cloth]] with oversleeves in the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] style and a hood worn low over the forehead to help to conceal the wearer's face. Dyed with [[spectra-fade dye]]<ref name="TVD" /> in an ombré, they began with [[Color/Legends|red]] at the hood and shifted into shades of orange before ending in yellow at the hem.<ref name="Fact File 104">{{FactFile|104|GAR 7-8|Garments and Couture}}</ref> They had a dark orange waistband and fitted red undersleeves that emerged from beneath the oversleeves and were accented with lace.<ref name="Episode I" />

As with many Naboo garments, they had a symbolic meaning: "Defiance of the Sunrise."<ref name="Fact File 110">{{FactFile|110|GAR 9-10|Garments and Couture}}</ref> The gradient was evocative of a [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] sunrise and suggested that the Naboo, like their sun, would once again rise.<ref name="Fact File 104" />

==History==
[[File:Amidala_lends_her_amulet_to_Sabe.png|thumb|left|250px|Padmé Amidala wore flame-colored robes while posing as one of her handmaidens.]]
The robes were worn by the [[Handmaiden/Legends|handmaidens]] who served [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] when she was the [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|monarch of Naboo]], along with the [[Queen/Legends|queen]] [[Gender/Legends|herself]] when she had to flee her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. Amidala wore the robes to pose as one of her own handmaidens while her decoy, [[Sabé/Legends|Sabé]], posed as the Queen.<ref name="Episode I" />

{{Clothes-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Flame-colored robes were created for the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']],<ref name="Episode I" /> which premiered on [[May 19]], [[1999]].<ref name="Year by Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> Prior to the film release, the robes first appeared in the [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|novelization]],<ref name="TPM novel">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization]]</ref> which was written by [[Terry Brooks]] and released on [[April 21]], and they were first identified in the [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (junior novelization)|junior novelization]], written by [[Patricia C. Wrede]] and released [[May 3]] of the same year.<ref name="TPM junior" />
